title: CI: Simplify conditional matrix, split fast-fail shards, and upgrade coverage toolchain
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Refactor CI matrix for faster failure detection, split long-running shards to enable early fast-fail, upgrade coverage tooling to coveragejs v4, adjust renovate rules; no runtime behavior changes.
description: Motivation: our current CI matrix has many conditional permutations which inflate queue time and make it hard to fail fast on clear breakages. This PR simplifies matrix logic by canonicalizing environment variables, extracts long-running integration/audio tests into separate 'long' shards that run concurrently but do not block fast-fail unit/linters, and upgrades the coverage toolchain to coveragejs v4 to fix flaky report generation. Changes include restoring clearer job names, reducing duplicated matrix entries, and tightening renovate dependency rules to avoid noisy minor bumps. Checklist: [x] Simplify matrix definitions and reduce permutations; [x] Add 'fast-fail' shard that contains unit tests and linters; [x] Add separate 'long' shard for integration/e2e and perf-canary tests; [x] Upgrade coverage tooling to coveragejs v4 and fix reporter flags; [x] Update docs and internal CI guide link (https://docs.redwood.dev/ci/matrix-guidelines); [x] Add tests for CI job name mapping. Context & links: related Linear tasks ENG-3721 and ENG-3745; previous PRs touched global CI templates (see pr-22341 and pr-24110). This PR intentionally avoids changing release hooks or deployment steps to limit blast radius.
